name: Traitors' Thursday
description:
**👀You’ve watched people lie, form alliances,** betray each other, defend themselves at the Round Table and desperately figure out WHO TO TRUST

**@HSRmeetups, you get to experience that feeling** **yourself.**
*Follow InstaGram @HSRmeetups for help, updates & upcoming events.*

*Games to be played:*
1\. The Werewolf
2\. Blood On The Clocktower
3\. Two Rooms & A Boom
.. & a few filler games to be played between main games

**🎭 Trust • Suspicion • Strategy • Betrayal**
7pm : Gates open
7:15pm : Introductions with fellow participants
7:30pm : Rules for 1st game start
8pm : First game starts
8pm : Rules for IInd game starts
8:30 : Second round of introductions with new participants. IInd game starts
9:30pm : IIIrd game starts with
completely different set of participants
10pm : IVth game starts
11pm : Night wrapped up.
***(You can join & leave anytime)***
***(4-5 total games to start/end at different times - so you can join & leave anytime, but try coming asap to get to play in most no. of games)***

*Follow InstaGram @HSRmeetups for help, updates & upcoming events.*

**🛡️ A SAFE, SUBSTANCE-FREE SPACE**
**@HSRmeetups**
***\- the largest substance\-free meetup community in Bangalore***
***\- with guaranteed safety\.***
[Click HERE to read our Code of Conduct](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cxUWP7MNaBwHVOHEN5khqm8KMqLnoTwk/view)

**💰 ON-THE-SPOT REGISTRATION**
**₹299 per person**
**₹249 per person** **for groups of** **3+ friends**

**❓ FAQ's:**
*“I haven't watched The Traitors. Can I still come?”*
**Of course. You don't need to know the show at all.**

*“I've never played social deduction before.”*
**We'll teach you.**

*“I'm coming alone/“I'm shy / introverted.””*
**Totally fine. We'll help you get into a game.**

*"Can I leave early?”*
**Yes. Come and leave at your convenience**
..
**Follow InstaGram** **@HSRmeetups** **for help, updates & upcoming events.**
